component.name: MyDay
component.summary: Personal schedule, tasks and logs — offline-first
个人日程 / 待办 / 记录管理，离线优先

description.p: MyDay unifies events (what will happen), tasks (what must be done) and logs (what happened) in one local SQLite database, with a full CLI and local IPC so scripts and agents can drive it.
日程（将发生）、待办（要完成）、记录（已发生）统一存本地 SQLite； 完整 CLI 与本地 IPC 让脚本和 agent 直接调用。提醒可靠：存意图、去重、 错过聚合。支持日历拖拽改期、重复规则、法定节假日、统计挂件与今日悬浮窗。
